# Kiro — captured 2026-09-02
# Source used: https://kiro.dev/changelog/ and https://kiro.dev/docs/cloud-sessions/
# *** STILL NOT IN sources.json — fourth consecutive scan recommending it. ***
# Kiro is AWS's NAMED REPLACEMENT for the Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins retiring 2027-04-30.

2026-09-01 *** CLOUD CONFIGURATION IN LOCAL SESSIONS (Web) *** REPORTED 09-02 HIGH/ENDPOINT
  "Configuration Sync now bridges cloud settings to LOCAL IDE AND CLI SESSIONS."
  Syncs **Steering files, custom agents, Skills, POWERS and Hooks** without replacing local files.
  Kiro docs: "your steering files, permissions, hooks, MCP SERVERS, and custom agents work
  identically whether you're in the IDE, CLI, or Web, with your .kiro/ configuration SHARED ACROSS
  ALL OF THEM."  POWERS "bundle MCP tools with knowledge and workflows" and "ACTIVATE DYNAMICALLY
  BASED ON CONTEXT."
  >>> COMBINED WITH WHAT WE ALREADY KNEW (2026-08-23/08-24):
      - custom agent config files carry an `mcpServers` field naming which MCP servers that agent
        may reach (plus `tools` and `toolAliases`)
      - MCP config exists at BOTH workspace and user scope
      - a FILE WATCHER on .kiro/agents and mcp.json HOT-RELOADS mid-session, no restart, no UI event
      - Powers HIDE plugin-format MCP servers from ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json
      => A REMOTE, CLOUD-SIDE CHANGE CAN NOW ALTER A LOCAL AGENT'S TOOL GRANTS AND MCP SERVER LIST,
         MID-SESSION, WITH NO RESTART, NO USER ACTION AND NO LOCAL CONTROL-PLANE EVENT.
      => configuration must be captured as a TIME SERIES, not a snapshot.
2026-09-01 KIRO WEB GENERALLY AVAILABLE — browser platform for building and delegating dev work;
  collaborative exploration, Specs for task shaping, end-to-end task handoff.
2026-09-01 OPENTELEMETRY METRICS EXPORT (GA) — admins export PER-USER usage metrics over OTLP to
  CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace, Elastic, Honeycomb, OpenSearch. Server-side daily at 02:00 UTC.
  => an ingestible telemetry stream where a customer already collects it.
2026-09-01 AWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. Scope includes Kiro, EXCLUDES Fable.
2026-08-31 Branch selection for repositories (Web) — cloud sessions no longer must start from the
  default branch; choose the branch in the GitHub/GitLab selector.
2026-08-27 IDE v1.0.395 — third-party VS Code extensions now compatible alongside Kiro;
  "support for the latest MCP protocol revision with more reliable sign-in"; fewer extension-host
  crashes on large agent responses; agent continuity across brief network interruptions.
2026-08-27 Sessions auto-naming (Web) — agent-generated titles; user-set names persist.
2026-08-26 CLI v2.20.0 — full-screen Spec task execution view, task scope selection, scrollback toggle.

Docs to watch: kiro.dev/docs/cloud-sessions/, /docs/custom-agents/configuration-reference/,
/docs/mcp/configuration/, /docs/skills/, /docs/steering/ (AGENTS.md recursive steering).
